basis.en: Computed, not measured: each 2020 Census block is counted whole by its internal point (inside a polygon, or within 400 m of a stop), with the block's 2020 residents and housing units.
basis.es: Calculado, no medido: cada bloque censal de 2020 se cuenta completo según su punto interno (dentro de un polígono, o a 400 m o menos de una parada), con los residentes y las unidades de vivienda del bloque en 2020.

inputs.blocks: 2020 Census blocks (TIGERweb layer 10): residents, housing units, internal point
inputs.flood: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, as published in flood.geojson (outlines simplified by about 5 m)
inputs.slr: NOAA Office for Coastal Management, Sea Level Rise Viewer data for Puerto Rico, 1 to 10 ft above mean higher high water (2017 data, file dated 2023-09-27)
inputs.surge: NOAA National Hurricane Center, SLOSH Maximum of MEOWs storm surge maps for Puerto Rico, category 1 to 5 at high tide (maps dated November 2018)
inputs.protected: USGS PAD-US, as published in protected.geojson
inputs.transit: stops (transport.json) and the end date of each operator's timetable (operators.json)

slr.en: Sea level rise · NOAA (connected to the ocean)
slr.es: Aumento del nivel del mar · NOAA (conectado al océano)

low.en: Sea level rise · NOAA (low-lying areas, not connected to the ocean)
low.es: Aumento del nivel del mar · NOAA (áreas bajas, sin conexión con el océano)

surge.en: Storm surge · NOAA NHC (near worst case, high tide)
surge.es: Marejada ciclónica · NOAA NHC (casi el peor caso, marea alta)

transit.es: Paradas de transporte a 400 m o menos
